snippet.title: The Boba Teashop | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461920/The_Boba_Teashop/

The Boba Teashop is a cozy horror game where you own and manage a boba teashop. Make boba teas, serve customers, and expand your menu of boba teas
